questions.prompt: If 14 \u00d7 12 = 168, which of these is also true?

choices.feedback: Both 168 \u00f7 12 = 14 and 168 \u00f7 14 = 12 are true. Choose the one that matches the given fact.

hints: Division is the inverse of multiplication.
If a \u00d7 b = c, then c \u00f7 b = a and c \u00f7 a = b.
questions.explanation: 14 \u00d7 12 = 168 means 168 \u00f7 12 = 14 and 168 \u00f7 14 = 12. Both are true; the question asks which is also true, so either works. The first listed is the direct inverse.
